# lyra-intel

> Lyra Intel is an intelligence platform designed to analyze repositories of any size - from small projects to enterprise monorepos with millions of lines of code. With 70+ components, it provides end-to-end analysis, security scanning, AI integration, and more. 

## Overview

lyra-intel is an open-source project by nirholas. Lyra Intel is an intelligence platform designed to analyze repositories of any size - from small projects to enterprise monorepos with millions of lines of code. With 70+ components, it provides end-to-end analysis, security scanning, AI integration, and more. 

## Repository

- URL: https://github.com/nirholas/lyra-intel
- Language: Python
- License: MIT
- Author: nirholas
